$comment: Figma <-> code sync matrix. Unlike contracts/manifest.json (regenerated by `pnpm docs:manifest` from local files only), this file CANNOT be regenerated by a local script — there is no Figma REST token configured in this repo. Checks are run by an agent with Figma MCP access (get_metadata / get_variable_defs against the file below) and the result is hand-recorded here. See `howToRefresh`. After building or updating a component in Figma, set its `syncedCommit` to the commit you synced against (`git rev-parse HEAD`) — `pnpm verify:stable` (scripts/figma-drift.ts) compares the component's tokens, CSS, visual props and contract at that commit against the working tree to show ✓ aligned / ⚠ out of date / ✗ not in Figma. Entries without `syncedCommit` fall back to the last commit on `lastChecked`'s day.
howToRefresh: Ask an agent with the figma-use skill to: (1) get_metadata on the component's Figma page/frame and compare its variant axes against the component's *.types.ts prop unions; (2) get_variable_defs on a representative node per variant/size/state and compare against that component's component.<name>.* tokens in packages/tokens/src/tokens.json; (3) update this entry by hand with the result and today's date.
typographyGapFoundAndFixed2026-08-24: Figma's local Text Styles (figma.getLocalTextStylesAsync()) covered 16 of the 20 named styles in semantic.textStyle — missing: body-m-semibold, heading-xl-bold, heading-2xl-bold, heading-3xl-bold (Figma only had the Semibold sibling for those three headings). Created all 4 in Figma, each bound to the same fontSize/lineHeight/fontFamily/fontWeight variables as their nearest sibling style. Component text should always be applied via a real named Figma text style (setTextStyleIdAsync), never a loose fontSize variable binding on its own — a loose binding misses fontWeight/lineHeight/fontFamily entirely and was the bug this note is recording so it isn't reintroduced. Also found and zeroed 6 text styles with stray non-zero letterSpacing (Caption/Semibold and Label/Uppercase were at 10%, four headings at -3%) — code's semantic.textStyle tokens never define letterSpacing, so every Figma text style's letterSpacing must be 0 to match; letter-spacing in code is only ever applied at the component-CSS level on top of the base style (e.g. Badge), never baked into the named style itself.
iconRule: STANDING RULE when building any component whose anatomy includes an icon: use a real instance from the Icons page (id 35:2) in this Figma file, never a placeholder shape (a dot/rect stand-in was used for IconButton's first draft and had to be redone). Icon components there are named by their Tabler name with the "Icon" prefix stripped (e.g. "Plus" for IconPlus, "Trash" for IconTrash) and default to a 24x24 box with a single stroke-only VECTOR child bound to icon/neutral. To use one: get the component via figma.getNodeByIdAsync(iconNodeId), call component.createInstance(), resize() to the target pixel size, then find the instance's VECTOR child and override its stroke's bound variable to the icon color actually needed (icon/inverse, icon/neutral, etc. per component.<name>.icon.* tokens) — do not leave it on the default icon/neutral binding when the component needs a different color per variant/state.

contractDiscoveredLate2026-08-24: .ai/skills/components-to-figma.md (+ tokens-to-figma.md, icons-to-figma.md) is the actual process contract for building a Helix component in Figma — mandatory combineAsVariants into one COMPONENT_SET, anatomy layer names must match data-helix-part, Phase 2.5 auto-layout (HUG width by default, FIXED height, counterAxisAlignItems=CENTER). These files were not read before building Badge/Chip/Avatar/IconButton/Checkbox/Switch/RadioGroup/Input/Select/Textarea this session, which is why they shipped as loose components with inconsistent alignment and clipped doc text — all 10 were retroactively fixed (see each entry's own STRUCTURAL FIX note). Read these three files FIRST, in full, before building any further Figma component — they are not linked from CLAUDE.md, so they're easy to miss.
figmaPropertyOrderingLimitation: Figma's own Properties panel ALWAYS groups Variant properties separately from Boolean/Text/InstanceSwap properties — confirmed via compSet.componentPropertyDefinitions on Chip: even though label/icon/iconEnd/dismissible were added via addComponentProperty AFTER variant/size/checked/disabled existed (from combineAsVariants), Object.keys() returned them in the order [label, icon, iconEnd, dismissible, variant, size, checked, disabled] — Boolean/Text/InstanceSwap first as a group, Variant last as a group, regardless of creation order. This is a Figma platform behavior, not a script bug: true prop-for-prop interleaving matching Storybook's Controls order (e.g. variant, size, checked, disabled, icon, iconEnd, dismissible all mixed together) is NOT achievable in Figma's UI. What IS controllable and was matched to Storybook's order: (1) the sequence WITHIN the Variant group, driven by segment order in each component's name string; (2) the sequence WITHIN the Boolean/Text/InstanceSwap group, driven by addComponentProperty call order. Both are now Storybook-order-matched for Chip; apply the same two-group ordering discipline to every future component.
combineAsVariantsCorruptionRule: CRITICAL: figma.combineAsVariants() must be called EXACTLY ONCE on any given set of components — never call it a second time on components that already have variantProperties from a prior combine, even after moving them out of their COMPONENT_SET onto a page first. Both Chip (adding a `disabled` axis) and Button (adding icon/spinner anatomy) hit this: the recombine completed without throwing, reported the expected child count, but left the COMPONENT_SET in a silent broken state only detectable by touching componentPropertyDefinitions or variantProperties afterward (which throw 'Component set for node has existing errors'), and node.name on every child degrades to a garbled '=value, =value' string with the property-name prefixes stripped. There is no repair API — the only fix is deleting the broken COMPONENT_SET and rebuilding the components from scratch (figma.createComponent(), not clone-and-rename of anything that was ever inside a COMPONENT_SET) in one single combineAsVariants call. What IS safe on an already-combined COMPONENT_SET, confirmed working repeatedly: appendChild/insertChild of new anatomy layers directly onto existing children (Badge's icon slot, IconButton's spinner, Input's iconEnd were all added this way with zero issues), plus addComponentProperty / componentPropertyReferences / editComponentProperty — anything that does NOT touch combineAsVariants or the child components' .name. Adding a genuinely NEW VARIANT AXIS to an existing set (not just a Boolean/Text/InstanceSwap property) has no safe in-place path — always delete and rebuild clean.
figmaPropertiesPhilosophy: Every component's properties should mirror its Storybook Controls panel: (1) skip props with no Figma equivalent — JS event handlers (onPress, onChange, onDismiss) and unstyled behavioral props with no visual difference (required when no asterisk is rendered, resize/rows/maxLength on Textarea); (2) a Boolean/Text/InstanceSwap property is only added once its anatomy layer genuinely exists — never wire a property to nothing just to make the panel look complete; (3) within Figma's own UI, Variant-type properties are ALWAYS grouped separately from Boolean/Text/InstanceSwap regardless of creation order (see figmaPropertyOrderingLimitation) — match Storybook's order WITHIN each of those two groups, true full interleaving isn't achievable on this platform.
